title: the question proof's BUILDME tooth reads its own lane, not the whole gate
intention: Tooth 3 of the question proof measures only its own BUILDME lane: an open question makes buildme_has_no_open_questions refuse the crossing, and once answered that lane no longer refuses, whatever other lanes say.
why: Measured 2026-11-17: with no open question on 9adc6fddf185 the questions lane reads none, but the crossing is refused by the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline (added by ticket c66b25d122e6), so the tooth that asserts the whole gate passes is red over a lane it does not test. Akien approved narrowing it: "sounds good to me".
traces_to: Law 9 (a red measures distance from the spec, and this one measured an unrelated lane); Law 3 (a tooth measures its own subject).
how: In teeth_door step 3 of the proof, read the bracketed finding [buildme_has_no_open_questions] in the refusal in both cases instead of requiring raised is None; reseal.

clauses.claim: with a question open on the ticket, the questions lane is red and the BUILDME refusal names [buildme_has_no_open_questions]
once the question is answered, the questions lane reads none and no BUILDME refusal names [buildme_has_no_open_questions], whatever other lanes refuse

decisions.text: D1: tooth 3 in teeth_door reads MARK = '[buildme_has_no_open_questions]': open, lanes[lane] not in (None,'none') and MARK in raised; answered, lanes[lane] == 'none' and (raised is None or MARK not in raised). The PROVES key stays as 9adc6fddf185 clause 3's address.
D2: reseal through bin/cairn test --reseal, which writes the validation beside the proof.

the outline check state of ticket 9adc6fddf185

measured.saw: with no open question, inspect_entry('9adc6fddf185') reads only the_ticket_was_checked_against_the_outline as closing, and the refusal names [buildme_rides_the_outline_check]
measured.how: the proof's gate subprocess run by hand over an empty scratch questions store
